chapter: The Second Herd and its sidemen
title: Retiring for seven months to be with family
summary: At the end of the First Herd he retired for about seven months for his family, then heard Ernie Royal.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well, was it -- at the end of this group's kind of period with you that you retired temporarily for awhile?

Yeah. And that lasted about seven months. We had just moved into this house and I wanted to see about -- I felt it was something I owed my family, and way overdue, and something I wanted to do. And I came, and I lasted seven months.
Then I heard a trumpet player by the name of Ernie Royal, and that started --
